dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: The target proposition universally quantifies over a measurable space Ω, a structured real function ψ, a measure μ, and an arbitrary real-valued function X, and asserts a conjunction giving an explicit infimum formula for a gauge and a finiteness characterization of membership.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the complete proposition being translated; both conjuncts must hold for every choice of the quantified objects.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type of structured real-valued functions; its constructor in D006 equips an underlying function with nonnegativity, convexity, monotonicity, normalization at zero, and divergence at positive infinity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The variable ψ ranges over this structured class, so the target does not concern arbitrary real functions ψ.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying-function projection from the structured object ψ, of type ℝ → ℝ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the scalar function evaluated inside the integral.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: For ψ, μ, and X, the gauge is the infimum in ℝ≥0∞ of all scales t satisfying the admissibility predicate D007.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The first conjunct unfolds this gauge, and the second compares it with infinity.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Membership of X for ψ and μ is defined to mean that the gauge D004 is strictly less than ∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The second conjunct is precisely the unfolding equivalence for this membership predicate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: A structured ψ can be constructed from f : ℝ → ℝ when f is nonnegative on [0,∞), convex on [0,∞), monotone on [0,∞), satisfies f(0)=0, and tends to +∞ as its argument tends to +∞.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are the mathematical constraints carried by ψ; they impose no stated conditions on f at negative arguments other than what may follow indirectly.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: A scale t : ℝ≥0∞ is admissible when t ≠ 0, t ≠ ∞, and the nonnegative integral D008 is at most 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies exactly the set whose infimum defines the gauge; the two inequalities restrict t to finite positive extended nonnegative reals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: The scale functional is ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal(ψ(|X(ω)| / t.toReal)) ∂μ.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the quantity constrained by ≤ 1 in admissibility. ENNReal.ofReal discards any negative value, although the ψ assumptions make the displayed input nonnegative for admissible t.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive-monoid-with-one structure supplies its additive-monoid-with-one parent structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is instance plumbing used to interpret the numeral 1 in ℝ≥0∞; it adds no separate hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: An additive monoid with one supplies the constant one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the upper bound 1 for the integral.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires both the gauge equality and the membership equivalence, and also combines the three scale-admissibility conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: CompleteLinearOrder.toConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot
dependency_coverage.meaning: A complete linear order induces the conditionally complete linear order with a bottom element used in the infimum hierarchy.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It helps provide the order structure under which the infimum of extended nonnegative reals is formed.

dependency_coverage.name: ConditionallyCompleteLattice.toConditionallyCompletePartialOrder
dependency_coverage.meaning: A conditionally complete lattice induces a conditionally complete partial order.

dependency_coverage.name: ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder.toConditionallyCompleteLattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: A conditionally complete linear order supplies a conditionally complete lattice.

dependency_coverage.name: ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot.toConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder

binders: A type Ω equipped with a measurable-space structure.
A structured function ψ whose underlying function is ℝ → ℝ.
An arbitrary function X : Ω → ℝ.
hypotheses: The structure on ψ requires its underlying function to be nonnegative, convex, and monotone on [0,∞), to satisfy ψ(0)=0, and to tend to +∞ as its argument tends to +∞.
conclusions: The gauge of X equals the infimum of all t : ℝ≥0∞ such that t ≠ 0, t ≠ ∞, and ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal(ψ(|X(ω)| / t.toReal)) ∂μ ≤ 1.
X belongs to the associated space if and only if its gauge is strictly less than ∞.
mathematical_definitions: The scale functional at t is the extended nonnegative integral ∫⁻ ω, ENNReal.ofReal(ψ(|X(ω)| / t.toReal)) ∂μ.
A scale t is admissible exactly when it is nonzero, finite, and its scale functional is at most 1.
The gauge is the infimum in ℝ≥0∞ of all admissible scales.
Associated-space membership is defined by finiteness of the gauge.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable space Ω, every admissible structured function ψ, every measure μ on Ω, and every real-valued function X on Ω, the associated extended-real gauge is exactly the infimum over finite positive scales t for which the nonnegative integral of ψ(|X|/t) is at most one; moreover, X is in the associated space exactly when that gauge is finite.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The measure μ is arbitrary: it is not assumed to be a probability measure or finite.
The function X is arbitrary and is not explicitly assumed measurable.
The structured ψ has an underlying function ℝ → ℝ, but its nonnegativity, convexity, and monotonicity requirements are stated only on [0,∞); no direct behavior is prescribed on negative arguments.
Admissible scales are elements of ℝ≥0∞ constrained by t ≠ 0 and t ≠ ∞, hence they correspond to finite positive scales before conversion with toReal.
The integrand uses ENNReal.ofReal, which truncates negative real values to zero; for admissible t the argument |X(ω)|/t.toReal is nonnegative, and ψ is assumed nonnegative there.
If there are no admissible scales, the infimum is still defined in the complete order ℝ≥0∞ and is ∞, so the associated membership proposition is false.
The proposition is a definitional consistency statement: it does not prove norm axioms, completeness, vector-space closure, almost-everywhere invariance, or existence of an admissible scale.
ambiguities: The dossier exposes the constructor for the structured ψ type but not an explicit declaration that this is its only constructor or named field projections beyond the underlying function; the stated constructor conditions nevertheless determine every ψ used by the target in ordinary use.
The mathematical behavior of the nonnegative integral on nonmeasurable integrands is inherited from its library definition and is not expanded beyond the opaque wrapper shown in the dossier.
